rules.title: Exclude Cancelled Admissions
rules.description: Analytics should ignore cancelled admissions unless explicitly requested by the user.

rules.title: Revenue Must Be Non-negative
rules.description: Revenue values should never be negative.

rules.title: Valid Length of Stay
rules.description: Length of stay cannot be negative.

rules.title: Discharge After Admission
rules.description: Discharge date must not be earlier than admission date.

rules.title: Default Date Column
rules.description: Use admission_date as the default date dimension when the user does not specify one.

rules.title: Default Sorting
rules.description: Sort date-based results in ascending order unless the user specifies otherwise.

rules.title: Default Result Limit
rules.description: Limit query results when no explicit limit is requested.
